project_type: Python WiFi reconnaissance and attack framework using Scapy
verification_instructions: Run python import check to verify no syntax errors. Cannot run actual tests as framework requires root and WiFi hardware.
setup_instructions: pip install scapy (already available in environment)
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages. Use AST/import validation only. Framework requires root and wireless hardware to actually run.
contribution_requirements: Branch fix/complete-audit-fixes, push to update existing PR #1
key_patterns: All modules follow class-based pattern with start()/stop() lifecycle, use threading for async operations, use scapy for packet crafting, use subprocess for system tools (hostapd/dnsmasq/iptables/iw). Logging via posframework.config.log. Platform detection via IS_WINDOWS/IS_LINUX.
directory_structure: posframework/ - single flat directory with all .py modules. No tests directory. No build files.
